description: A reply to a code reviewer padded with flattery, intensifiers, and jargon: opens with agreement instead of the fact, frames the point with 'the key insight', and calls the bug a 'load-bearing seam' and a 'footgun' instead of saying what happens.

input.assignment: Reply on a pull request thread to a reviewer who found that two different interpolation expressions compared as equal. Say whether the finding holds and what was changed.
